**Finding (repaired and resubmitted): Compliant** — no redline, no counterparty comment.

The verifier's narrative confirmed the verdict on each substantive dimension, so the repair tightened the evidentiary basis rather than changing the conclusion:

- **Added diligence on the remaining unread section.** I read the Preamble and full definitions block (p0000–p0036) end to end. Nothing there creates a hiring restriction; the only "employ" references are the Content Administrator definition and the indemnity clauses.
- **Re-anchored the quote** to § 14.16 ("Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others."), which is affirmatively customer-favourable, and trimmed the cited paragraphs to the three that carry the operative text.
- **Kept the record clean of any edit.** No `propose_redline` call was made, since the earlier byte-identical redline added nothing; a compliant finding should carry no ops at all.
- **Explained the failed sub-checks explicitly**: satisfying a 12-month cap or a general-solicitation carve-out would require first drafting a non-solicit into the agreement against ourselves. Absence is the better outcome for Bluefly, so those checks are non-probative.
- **Retained the residual-scope caveat** for Order Forms, Attachment A and the Service Option Attachments, with the fallback position ready if a restriction surfaces there.

Confidence restored to 0.90 on the strength of the completed read-through.
